ordinary_actions.scope: Ordinary choices have no primary-output trigger field. Same-step and previous REGULAR_COMMIT output releases are observational relations, not causal ancestry. Later ordinary actions after its own release are separate Q1 opportunities, not spare-follow-up recursion. An async load receipt is admission, not transfer completion.

limitations: All three paths use the same already-seen input but have independent scheduling trajectories.
Ordinary free-fit backfill is a strong simple baseline action, not a complete reproduction of CacheOPT or UniBoost.
Action events within one run are not independent replicates; all displaced-request costs remain in the full-cohort metrics.
This challenge is neither fresh confirmation nor a novelty claim.
